  collapse = TRUE,

```{r setup}
library(redcapi2b2)
library(readr)


emergecdp_redcap_dd <- read_csv(system.file("examples", "emerge_cdp", "R4ClinicalDataPlatformCDP_DataDictionary_2024-06-28.csv", package="redcapi2b2"))

emerge_redcap_inst <- read_csv(system.file("examples", "emerge_cdp", "R4ClinicalDataPlatformCDP_inst.csv", package="redcapi2b2"))

emerge_tidy_dd <- tidy_redcap_dictionary(
  redcap_dd = emergecdp_redcap_dd,
  instrument_labels = emerge_redcap_inst
)

emerge_i2b2_ontology <- redcap_i2b2_ontology(emerge_tidy_dd, 
                                             project_id = "emerge_cdp",
                                             concept_cd_prefix = "EMCDP:")


emerge_i2b2_ontology[1:10,1:3]
```
